task.title: Relics: explore replaying the other local changes after a conflict
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding D26). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

When a sync stops on a relic conflict, it lists every other local change it did not apply (`unapplied`, with the commit that holds each). The person makes those changes again by hand after resolving the conflict.

## Wanted

Explore replaying the unapplied changes automatically once the conflict is resolved: which changes are safe to replay, what happens when one of them conflicts in turn, and what the person is told.

## Done when

- A written design with the replay rules and the cases that still need a person.
- A recommendation on whether to build it.

## Notes

Dylan asked for this on 2026-11-26 when he approved listing the changes.
